bypass_identification.root_cause: The launcher UI performed natural-language classification and immediate string generation before constructing RequestEnvelope and before reaching AstraApplication.handle_request.
bypass_identification.architectural_hazard: Bypassed RequestBoundaryRouter classification, circumvented REQUEST_INGRESS_CLASSIFIED and REQUEST_DOWNSTREAM_SELECTED telemetry, and created an unobservable UI-level semantic decision authority.

remediation_plan.action: Eradicate the NATURAL_LANGUAGE short-circuit in execute_command. Route all typed text into RequestEnvelope(origin=RequestOrigin.LAUNCHER) -> astra_app.handle_request -> RequestBoundaryRouter.
remediation_plan.meta_preservation: Pure greetings ('hello', 'hi', 'thanks') are classified by RequestBoundaryRouter as META_COMMAND -> _handle_meta_command -> type='conversational', which Launcher renders cleanly in show_feedback.
remediation_plan.composite_protection: Compound greetings ('hello, open calculator') fail-closed at RequestBoundaryRouter to OPERATIONAL_GOAL and execute downstream, preventing conversational swallowing of operational verbs.
remediation_plan.suggestion_remediation: In _execute_result, wrap selected suggestion in RequestEnvelope(origin=RequestOrigin.LAUNCHER) before calling app.handle_request.
